items.title: Lillie Delk Christian Interview, 1961-04-25
items.q: Well, Delbert Bright had been in Albert Hammond's band

ctx.x: Club de Lisa when you started. Yeah. Delbert Bright. Mm-hmm.
Well, Delbert Bright had been in Albert Hammond's band, and, uh, Albert was, uh, had left and was over at the Etcler. Mm-hmm. Or something of the sort about that time around the corner from... Yeah.
And then he was, it wasn't long before, um... Saunders. Red, Red Saunders came in. Mm-hmm. Mm-hmm.
